explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/698: Bergman 'proved that for any 2 ≤ i < j ≤ n/2, gcd(C(n,i), C(n,j)) ≫ n^{1/2} 2^i / i^{3/2}, where the implied constant is absolute.'
